note: Rules as data. Every legal or operational fact the recovery agent uses lives here, never in Python. Each entry carries operator/value where a number is compared, a bilingual label, the source {outlet, date, url}, the sentence as reported (quote; checked against the live page by scripts/verify_sources.py) and a caveat. Press reports are never presented as law.
caveatSuffix: confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: Haryana: e-Zero FIR for cyber financial fraud of Rs 1 lakh or more reported through 1930
label.hi: हरियाणा: 1930 पर दर्ज 1 लाख रुपये या उससे अधिक की साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी पर e-Zero FIR

haryana.quote: if a victim of cyber financial fraud involving ₹ 1 lakh or more reports the matter through helpline 1930, the helpline police team will fill e-zero FIR form based on the information provided by the complainant
haryana.caveat: Reported by Hindustan Times on 25 Jun 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: Rajasthan: automatic e-Zero FIR for cyber financial fraud of Rs 1 lakh or more
label.hi: राजस्थान: 1 लाख रुपये या उससे अधिक की साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी पर स्वतः e-Zero FIR

rajasthan.quote: Victims of cyber financial fraud involving Rs 1 lakh or more in Rajasthan will now have an e-Zero FIR registered automatically immediately after reporting of the crime
rajasthan.caveat: Reported by Times of India on 23 Jul 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: Punjab: e-Zero FIR for cyber financial fraud above Rs 5 lakh
label.hi: पंजाब: 5 लाख रुपये से अधिक की साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी पर e-Zero FIR

punjab.quote: Punjab Police has launched the e-Zero FIR mechanism for cyber financial fraud cases involving fraudulent transactions above Rs 5 lakh
punjab.caveat: Reported by New Indian Express on 29 Jul 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: Supreme Court directed all States/UTs to adopt e-Zero FIR (13-point directions, 4 Aug 2026)
label.hi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने सभी राज्यों/केंद्र-शासित प्रदेशों को e-Zero FIR अपनाने का निर्देश दिया (13 सूत्रीय निर्देश, 4 अगस्त 2026)

scDirection.quote: the remaining States which have not yet done so are directed to notify and operationalise their State Cyber Crime Coordination Centres within four weeks; and take steps to adopt the e-Zero FIR mechanism, in consultation with I4C
scDirection.caveat: Reported by New Indian Express on 4 Aug 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

defaultNote.en: Check with 1930; SC ordered all states to adopt e-Zero FIR (Aug 2026)
defaultNote.hi: 1930 से पुष्टि करें; सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने सभी राज्यों को e-Zero FIR अपनाने का आदेश दिया (अगस्त 2026)

label.en: Up to Rs 50,000 frozen in a single account: refund on a police report and indemnity bond, no FIR or court order
label.hi: एक खाते में 50,000 रुपये तक रुकी राशि: पुलिस रिपोर्ट और क्षतिपूर्ति बॉन्ड पर रिफ़ंड, FIR या कोर्ट आदेश नहीं

noFirUpTo.quote: refunds up to ₹50,000 frozen in a single account can be processed without an FIR or court order, based on a police report and indemnity bond submitted online
noFirUpTo.caveat: Reported by Deccan Chronicle on 8 Jun 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: More than Rs 50,000 in a single account: an FIR is mandatory
label.hi: एक खाते में 50,000 रुपये से अधिक: FIR अनिवार्य

firMandatoryAbove.quote: If the held amount exceeds Rs50,000 in a single bank account, lodging an FIR is mandatory under the rules.
firMandatoryAbove.caveat: Reported by Free Press Journal on 21 Aug 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: MRM is only for complaints registered promptly on 1930/NCRP with a 14-digit acknowledgement number, and only for money still frozen
label.hi: MRM केवल 1930/NCRP पर तुरंत दर्ज शिकायतों (14 अंकों का पावती नंबर) और रुकी हुई राशि के लिए है

ackRequired.quote: the portal (MRM) is strictly for victims who registered their complaint immediately via the 1930 Helpline or the NCRP portal and possess a 14-digit Registered Acknowledgement Number
ackRequired.caveat: Reported by Free Press Journal on 21 Aug 2026; confirm with 1930 before relying on it

checklist: Bank account details of the victim (account number, IFSC, cancelled cheque or passbook)
Indemnity bond (as per the MRM portal format)
mrm.checklistFir: FIR copy (mandatory: more than Rs 50,000 in a single account)
mrm.checklistNoFir: No FIR needed (Rs 50,000 or less in a single account); police report and indemnity bond are enough

label.en: Incident details: minimum 200 characters, no special characters
label.hi: घटना का विवरण: कम से कम 200 अक्षर, विशेष चिह्न नहीं

narrativeMinChars.quote: Incident details (minimum 200 characters) without any special characters
narrativeMinChars.caveat: Reported by National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in); confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: Financial fraud: 12-digit transaction id / UTR number, date and amount per transaction
label.hi: वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी: हर लेन-देन का 12 अंकों का ट्रांज़ैक्शन आईडी/UTR, तारीख और राशि

transactionIdDigits.caveat: Reported by National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in); confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: A soft copy of a national ID of the complainant is mandatory
label.hi: शिकायतकर्ता के राष्ट्रीय पहचान-पत्र की सॉफ्ट कॉपी अनिवार्य

idUploadRequired.quote: Soft copy of any national Id ( Voter Id, Driving license, Passport, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card) of complainant
idUploadRequired.caveat: Reported by National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in); confirm with 1930 before relying on it

label.en: A 1930 complaint returns a 14-digit acknowledgement number starting with 329
label.hi: 1930 पर शिकायत का 14 अंकों का पावती नंबर 329 से शुरू होता है

ackNumber.quote: the victim receives a message with a 14-digit acknowledgement number starting with “329”
ackNumber.caveat: Reported by The Hindu (Chennai) on 15 Aug 2025; confirm with 1930 before relying on it
ackNumber.warning: Ack numbers reported in the press start with 329; double-check

narrative.padSentence: The complainant requests that the transactions be traced and the beneficiary accounts be frozen at the earliest so that the amount can be recovered.
